description: Consumer-side dependency-update configuration for this catalog repository.

The publish workflow runs inside a tooling image pulled from a private OCI registry (hub.aggrega.ai/tools/aggrega), pinned by tag in .github/workflows/catalog-publish-sign.yml. When a newer image tag is published an update pull request should open here so a human adopts it deliberately; adoption is never automatic. The container image reference in that workflow is read by the built-in github-actions manager, so no custom manager is needed to track it.

NOT YET CONFIRMED against a live registry and a live update bot: the private OCI-registry datasource (tag enumeration on hub.aggrega.ai, plus the registry credentials, which are configured in the operator's bot as host rules rather than committed here) is authored from the documented docker datasource behavior and must be validated against the real registry before it is relied on. The plugin-ABI compatibility gate in the workflow protects the publish regardless of whether this configuration successfully opens pull requests.

packageRules.description: Adopt the tooling image only through a reviewed, human-merged pull request; never auto-merge it, and keep it in its own labelled PR so the paired ABI-compatibility review is not skipped.
